source.description: Expected values for VoxCPMCore (Issue #574), cut from the CPU float32 reference capture of Issue #571 and checked again against the upstream code.
source.floatEncoding: Every float array is base64 of IEEE 754 binary32 values in little-endian byte order.

layouts.prompts: tokenIDs are the upstream tokenizer.tokenize IDs before the split (no BOS); expectedIDs are the upstream mask_multichar_chinese_tokens IDs followed by the audio start token 101.
layouts.vocabulary: A subset of the pinned vocabulary (token string by ID) that holds every ID of the prompts, the multi-character kanji tokens they reach after removing U+2581 and their single characters, plus the canonically equivalent pair 59375 (U+003B) and 70138 (U+037E) of the full vocabulary.
layouts.noise: Per patch, torch.randn((1, 64, 4)) after torch.manual_seed(1708), 256 values in row-major order (channel-major, 64 x 4), drawn in patch order 0..33.
layouts.solver: Patches 0, 13 and 33. ditHidden is mu (2048), condition is cond (64 x 4, the previous latent, zeros for patch 0). calls are the nine estimator calls of steps 2..10: x and velocity are 2 x 64 x 4 (row 0 conditional with mu, row 1 unconditional with mu = 0), t and dt are 2 values. The expected mu input is ditHidden followed by 2048 zeros and the expected cond input is condition twice. latent is the solver output (64 x 4).
layouts.stopLogits: Per patch, the stop head output (2 values); index 1 is the stop decision.
